transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2025-11-10
Time: 15:00 - 15:45 PT
Duration: ~45 minutes
Attendees: Olivia Park, Marcus Chen, Priya Nair, Daniel Ortiz, Ethan Ramos, Jasmine Lee, Ava Martinez
Links shared: Draft slides (wip): http://bit.ly/redwood-webinar-deck | Landing page draft: https://redwood.ai/events/webinar-llm-inference (placeholder) | Demo clip upload: drive.redwood/example

Summary:
Quick sync for the Nov 20 webinar 'Scaling LLM Inference in Production'. Focus: agenda finalization, marketing funnel, assets, rehearsal schedule, and responsibilities. Discussed target audience (platform teams, infra/ML engineers), messaging (cost/latency tradeoffs, hosted vs dedicated vs private), and promotional plan (email, LinkedIn, paid social). Decided on a recorded demo + short live Q&A, confirm panelists, track registrations via HubSpot UTMs, and run a tech rehearsal one week prior.

Transcript:
[00:00] Olivia: Okay hi everyone, thanks for joining, uh, we'll kick off, it's 3pm Pacific. Quick roll call?
[00:05] Marcus: Marcus here.
[00:06] Priya: Priya, hi.
[00:07] Daniel: Daniel.
[00:08] Ethan: Ethan.
[00:09] Jasmine: Jasmine.
[00:09] Ava: Ava.

[00:15] Olivia: Cool. So objective today is to lock the run of show, make sure we have the assets timeline, and decide which portions are live vs recorded. We have two weeks until the webinar on Nov 20, so timeline's tight.

[00:30] Marcus: My recommendation — keep the demo short, like 8 to 10 minutes, pre-record it. Then do a 20 minute panel + 15 minute live Q&A. When we did the last infra webinar, the live demo had flubbed timing and ate up Q&A.

[00:45] Priya: Agreed. From growth side, recorded demo converts similarly if it's crisp, and it reduces risk. We should also capture a 60-second teaser for social.

[01:05] Daniel: I'll mock up a 16x9 hero and social tiles, plus an animated 15s clip for LinkedIn. Need final slide deck to match brand.

[01:20] Olivia: On speakers — confirmed panelists: Ethan will moderate, Jasmine will cover product vision, and we want a short customer snippet. Ava, you had a customer in mind?

[01:30] Ava: I pinged Finity Labs, they said maybe, waiting on confirmation. If Finity can't make it, we can use a case study we recorded earlier, or a partner from LaunchPad.

[01:45] Ethan: I'm happy to moderate and do a short sales handoff at the end with the call-to-action for a Pilot. We should align on the CTA: register -> on-demand + request pilot -> sales outreach within 48 hours.

[02:05] Marcus: Messaging: lead with a pain point — latency and cost unpredictability — and show how routing, batching, and dedicated pools move the needle. Keep technical depth but not too deep; audience is platform engineers not model researchers. Expect questions about quantization and net-new kernels, so have an SE-ready FAQ.

[02:35] Jasmine: I'll draft 3 talking points: product differentiators (unified runtime, cost-aware routing, private deployments), then a short roadmap blurb. Also we'll need to confirm compliance mentions — SOC 2, KMS integrations, and data residency — should be baked into the slide to reassure enterprise attendees.

[03:00] Priya: For acquisition: email to existing leads, two reminder sequences, LinkedIn posts from speaker profiles, and a small paid LinkedIn boost targeted at infra/platform job titles. Budget estimate? $1k-$2k to test.

[03:20] Olivia: Is that enough to hit our registration target of 400 signups? Last webinar with similar topic hit 300 organic signups, so with paid it should get to 400. Also we should set an attendee conversion target of 30% live attendance.

[03:45] Ava: On registration — make sure HubSpot form captures company size, role, and ask 'Are you evaluating new inference solutions?' so sales can triage. Also add a question for consent to be contacted.

[04:10] Priya: I'll set UTMs and pass them to Ethan for sales routing. We'll also include hidden fields for campaign id so we can attribute.

[04:25] Marcus: Demo outline — quick architecture diagram, live perf numbers (p95 latency, tokens/sec), and a short walkthrough of the console: choosing model variants, pinning versions, and a quick peek at the Optimize recommendations. Daniel, we need visuals for each.

[04:45] Daniel: Yup I'll produce three slides: architecture, perf dashboard screenshot (mock data), and Optimize UI mock. I'll need the perf numbers — Olivia or Jasmine can provide recent benchmarks?

[05:05] Olivia: I'll pull the benchmark spreadsheet and share. Note: don't show any raw logs or PII. Do we need a security blurb slide? Jasmine suggested we mention SOC 2 and KMS.

[05:20] Jasmine: Yes, include a short slide on security and compliance. Also add a 'when to choose private vs dedicated vs hosted' decision matrix — that's a strong piece of content.

[05:40] Priya: For follow-up assets: on-demand recording, slides PDF, one-pager 'how to evaluate inference providers' and an exec summary for sales. Marcus, you said you'd write the one-pager?

[05:52] Marcus: I will draft the one-pager. Also I'll produce two snippets for social and the intro script for the moderator.

[06:10] Olivia: Rehearsal — propose Monday Nov 17 at 9am PT for tech check and run of show, all presenters should attend.

[06:20] Ethan: Works for me.

[06:25] Daniel: Works.

[06:30] Ava: Works.

[06:35] Olivia: Good. Promotion cadence — Priya, what are email send dates?

[06:40] Priya: Draft send: Nov 6 (announce), Nov 13 (reminder), Nov 18 (final reminder). We'll do paid starting Nov 10 for 7 days.

[06:55] Jasmine: For panelist bios — need headshots and 2-3 sentence bios. I'll collect from presenters by Nov 12.

[07:10] Olivia: Any other risks? Platform demo failing live, low registration, or last-minute speaker dropouts. Mitigations: pre-record demo, backup panelist, test environment for demo, and clear sales follow-up script.

[07:25] Marcus: Also potential tough questions around model hallucinations and safety — we should prepare a short script and FAQ.

[07:40] Olivia: Great. Let's recap actions: Olivia share benchmarks + deck by Nov 14; Marcus produce demo clip and one-pager; Priya landing page and UTMs; Daniel design assets; Jasmine collect bios and draft security slide; Ethan prepare moderation script and sales CTA; Ava confirm customer panelist. Rehearsal Nov 17.

[08:05] Olivia: Anything else? (brief pause) okay, that's it. Thanks everyone.

[08:15] (meeting ends)
